method_label: 显式端边界插值构造，尚非Parasolid一般语义认证

parameters.end_boundary_law: explicit linear interpolation of cylinder UV end boundaries between the measured vertical and horizontal contact extents; not a general Parasolid trim law

actual_geometry.scope: Sampled local contact and curvature checks. Infinite-plane G0/G1, finite-face attachment, CAD validity, trim semantics and human acceptance remain separate.

validation_boundary: Only an explicit analytic cylindrical patch with the declared local boundary rule. Finite wall overhang is measured, not hidden; no general native face-face or Parasolid trim-mode acceptance.
